text:
The assistant correctly adopted the requested persona of a relationship coach and responded with empathy and professionalism. 

Because the user's initial request ("I require assistance in resolving conflicts between my spouse and me") was a general statement of need rather than a specific scenario, the assistant correctly identified that it lacked the necessary data to provide actionable advice. Instead of giving generic, one-size-fits-all relationship tips, the assistant asked targeted clarifying questions to gather the "details about two individuals" mentioned in the prompt's instructions. This ensures that the eventual guidance will be tailored and relevant.

The response is concise, appropriate for the stage of the conversation, and sets a supportive tone.

Rating: [[10]]
